title: themes deliverable rubric
description: Per-deliverable expert subagent for #themes output. Audits the theme-yield-guarantee (BREADTH_FLOOR ≥20), theme deduplication/distinctiveness (no near-duplicate clusters), evidence anchoring (every theme carries verbatim quotes with named-source attribution), and the cluster-grounding from BERTopic. Returns a structured verdict that drives the critic-revise loop for thin theme runs.

anchors.5: fully meets the criterion as the five column states
anchors.3: present but partially met or partially traced
anchors.1: absent, fabricated, or as the one column states

criteria.label: Evidence anchoring
criteria.five: Every theme has ≥1 verbatim quote with named-source attribution
criteria.one: Themes without quotes or with paraphrased "evidence"

criteria.label: Distinctiveness
criteria.five: No 2 themes are near-duplicates of each other (>70% topic overlap)
criteria.one: 3+ themes saying the same thing with different framings

criteria.label: Citation diversity
criteria.five: Across all themes, ≥50% citations are external (not client-upload PDFs)

criteria.label: Naming determinism
criteria.five: If this is a re-run on cached corpus, theme NAMES match the prior run
criteria.one: Theme names drift between identical-input runs

criteria.label: Cluster grounding
criteria.five: Themes correlate to BERTopic cluster_ids (cluster_id field present + populated for ≥80% of themes)

criteria.label: isCrossDocument accuracy
criteria.five: Themes flagged isCrossDocument=true actually cite 2+ distinct source documents

criteria.label: Anti-slop in theme names
criteria.five: No metaphor names ("The Building Blocks of X", "Navigating the Y Landscape"); plain descriptive names

criteria.label: Anti-slop in insights
criteria.five: No meta-commentary, no anthropomorphism, no hyperbole
criteria.one: "The data demands...", hyperbole from the banned list

criteria.label: Source-stratification flag
criteria.five: If themes are mostly internal-corpus-only, the substrate flag is raised honestly (not hidden)

criteria.label: Cached-selection coverage
criteria.five: ≥80% of the user's KL-curated items appear in the emission as source: cached or source: extended; new items have source: new; coverage is reported as cached_selection_coverage_pct in the verdict
criteria.one: <60% coverage (auto Stop-hook reject via validate_cached_selection_honored.py); model regenerated from scratch and ignored the user's curation

decision.approve: yield ≥20 AND evidence anchoring ≥4 AND distinctiveness ≥3
decision.revise: yield 15-19 (trigger upstream substrate augmentation via wiki-query-expander + analog-finder per evidence-density-pre-checker SKILL) OR distinctiveness 2 (merge candidates)
decision.reject: yield <15 OR evidence anchoring ≤2 OR any fabricated quotes

verdict_rule.refine: any criterion scored below its floor
verdict_rule.pass: every scored criterion at or above its floor
